The signed enthalpy increment per mole of added feed and its exact parameter
columns are checked on the manufactured neutral and ionic declarations of
[the original study](README.md). The observable is
$\Delta h_{add}=(H^{(2)}-H^{(1)})/n_{add}-h_{feed}$ in joules per mole of added
feed. The initial and final equilibrium states and the feed state retain the
same reactions, references, starts and fitted coordinates.

## Named-release rerun (#680)

This section reads only the retained named-release outputs. The evidence is
**numerical verification** on the stated manufactured or shared-model inputs.
It establishes no physical validation or global-stability certificate.
Independent delivered review and owner promotion for manuscript use remain open.

```{python}
#| output: asis
import csv as _csv
import json as _json
from pathlib import Path as _Path
_rr = _Path("results/main-8298c602")
_rp = _json.loads((_rr / "provenance.json").read_text())
_rs = _json.loads((_rr / "summary.json").read_text())
def _rt(headers, data):
    print()
    print("| " + " | ".join(headers) + " |")
    print("| " + " | ".join("---" for _ in headers) + " |")
    for row in data:
        print("| " + " | ".join(str(x) for x in row) + " |")
print("Release: `" + _rp["release"] + "`. Wheel SHA-256: `" + _rp["wheel_sha256"] + "`.")
_rt(["Quantity", "Named release", "Previous retained run", "Criterion"], [
    ["Column comparisons, both declared steps", _rs['comparisons'], _rs['previous_comparisons'], "unchanged native allowance for each row"],
    ["Fine-step comparisons", _rs['fine_comparisons'], _rs['fine_comparisons'], "same steps and coordinates"],
    ["Largest error / allowance, both steps", _rs['max_error_over_allowance'], _rs['previous_max_error_over_allowance'], "ratio at most unity"],
    ["Largest fine-step error / allowance", _rs['max_fine_error_over_allowance'], "see prior comparisons.csv", "ratio at most unity"],
    ["Failed column comparisons", _rs['failed'], "none in prior table", "native verdict"],
])
print("\n" + _rs['criterion'])
```

The complete requests, returned operands, causes and wheel identity stay in
[the retained run](results/main-8298c602/). No start, physical input, method,
option or criterion was adjusted to obtain agreement.

The native prediction and independently re-solved reference are retained for
every column at both declared steps. The allowance formula is unchanged; its
evaluated magnitude can move with the re-solved derivative. These manufactured
comparisons test the enthalpy derivative chain and do not compare measured heat
or adopt application parameters.
